scientific_limitations: Treats the nonunital radical J=(t) in K[t;sigma]/(t^4) for all finite fields K=F_{q^m}, m>=2, sigma(a)=a^q, not arbitrary skew automorphisms, other truncation lengths, or the full ring. title: Maximal commuting subalgebras and a parity incidence law in Frobenius-skew nilpotent radicals
